for_whom.label: Who it's for
for_whom.title: A triathlon club on race day
for_whom.description: PSC is a triathlon club that organises a supersprint triathlon. On race day, athletes, organisers and spectators all want the same thing: the results, quickly and without searching.

what_we_did.label: What we did
what_we_did.title: Live results, on any phone
what_we_did.description: We built a web app, with nothing to install, that shows the results during the race and keeps them online afterwards.

items.live_results: Results shown live, during the race
items.rankings: An overall ranking, plus rankings by category and gender
items.podiums: Podiums for each year, easy to look back on
items.athlete_pages: A page for each athlete, with their results
items.organiser_space: A private area where organisers enter the results

result.label: Result
result.title: A race that is easier to follow
result.description: Athletes find their performances on their phones, spectators follow the rankings live, and organisers manage the results easily, from their own area.
